template_name: Case Study Letter — Baxter / Life Sciences
design_notes: Two-column layout. Hero headline + subtitle at top. Stats impact bar (4 stats + labels). Left column: single combined Challenge + Solution narrative frame (TEXT_CHALLENGE_BODY). Right column: services bullet list (TEXT_SERVICES_BODY). Section header between hero and stats bar (TEXT_SECTION_HEADER). Poppins typeface throughout. Footer brand elements are locked.

TEXT_TITLE.note: Hero headline — primary value proposition, e.g. 'Globally Scaling HCP Engagement for Baxter'

TEXT_SUBTITLE.note: Supporting subheadline below hero — one sentence describing the campaign outcome

TEXT_SECTION_HEADER.note: Impact stats section header, e.g. 'One Team, Big Impact'

TEXT_STAT_01.note: Stat 1 large value — number only, e.g. '20%+'

TEXT_STAT_01_LABEL.note: Stat 1 descriptor below the number, e.g. 'Increase in Division Sales'

TEXT_CHALLENGE.note: Left column combined narrative — write as flowing paragraphs covering both the challenge and solution. The frame (TEXT_CHALLENGE_BODY) holds the full left-column text block.

TEXT_SERVICES.note: Right column services list — one service per line. Maps to TEXT_SERVICES_BODY frame.

IMAGE_HERO.note: Center image zone — campaign photo, speaker headshot, or product visual
